text: AKEBONO BRAKE INDUSTRY's principal shareholders as of 31 March 2026 were Japan Industrial Solutions Fund II with 50.7%, Toyota Motor Corporation with 5.7% and Isuzu Motors with 4.4%.
short: Japan Industrial Solutions Fund II holds 50.7% of Akebono Brake.
